beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and ML newcomers who need to use the Hugging Face platform productively. Covers the Hub (models, datasets, Spaces, collections), model cards, licences and gated access, access tokens, the hf CLI and huggingface_hub library, the local cache, the datasets library, creating and versioning repositories, a first Gradio app and Space, and first calls to Inference Providers. Transformer architecture and the transformers library are covered in the separate Transformers course.
prerequisites: Writes basic Python scripts and uses pip and virtual environments
Uses a terminal and git concepts such as commit, branch and tag
Has internet access, a free Hugging Face account and a laptop that can run Python 3.10 or later
outcomes: Find, evaluate and legally use models and datasets from the Hub
Authenticate and move assets with the hf CLI and huggingface_hub, and manage the local cache
Load and transform data with the datasets library and publish versioned repositories with proper cards
Ship a Gradio demo as a Space and call hosted models through Inference Providers
